title: Panniculectomy and Abdominoplasty
jurisdiction: CMS Hospital Outpatient Prior Authorization (42 CFR § 419.80)
description: CMS prior authorization for panniculectomy. Mandates pannus hanging below the level of the pubis symphysis, documented chronic intertrigo, cellulitis, or ulceration unresponsive to at least 3 months of medical therapy, and stable weight for >= 6 months if post-bariatric surgery.

criteria.name: Severe Apron/Pannus (Hanging Below Pubis Symphysis)
criteria.description: Photographic and clinical examination confirming the pannus/abdominal apron hangs below the level of the pubis symphysis.
criteria.cms_document: CMS OPD Prior Authorization Program Guide

criteria.name: Refractory Intertrigo / Dermatitis (>= 3 Months Medical Therapy)
criteria.description: Documented chronic intertrigo, maceration, or fungal infection under the pannus refractory to >= 3 months of prescribed topical or systemic medical therapy.
criteria.clinical_intent: Confirm medical necessity due to persistent chronic infection
criteria.cms_document: CMS OPD Prior Authorization Program Guide

criteria.name: Cosmetic Body Contouring Exclusion
criteria.description: Panniculectomy or abdominoplasty performed for body contouring or cosmetic aesthetic improvement without functional infection or pannus below pubis.
criteria.cms_document: CMS OPD Prior Authorization Program Guide

cms_reference.notes: Verified against CMS OPD Program. Panniculectomy is a statutorily designated prior authorization service under 42 CFR § 419.80.
